class.name: OcgGraphic3dShadermanager
class.brief_description: This class is responsible for generation of shader programs.
class.description: ! This class is responsible for generation of shader programs.

method.name: IsGapiGreaterEqual
method.description: Returns true if detected GL version is greater or equal to requested one.

method.name: UseRedAlpha
method.description: Return TRUE if RED channel should be used instead of ALPHA for single-channel textures (e.g. GAPI supports only GL_RED textures and not GL_ALPHA).

method.name: SetUseRedAlpha
method.description: Set if RED channel should be used instead of ALPHA for single-channel textures.

method.name: HasFlatShading
method.description: Return flag indicating flat shading usage; TRUE by default.

method.name: ToReverseDFdxSign
method.description: Return flag indicating flat shading should reverse normal flag; FALSE by default.

method.name: SetFlatShading
method.description: Set flag indicating flat shading usage.

method.name: ToEmulateDepthClamp
method.description: Return TRUE if depth clamping should be emulated by GLSL program; TRUE by default.

method.name: SetEmulateDepthClamp
method.description: Set if depth clamping should be emulated by GLSL program.

method.name: HasGlslExtension
method.description: Return TRUE if specified extension is available.

method.name: EnableGlslExtension
method.description: Set if specified extension is available or not.
